decision.article_title: 上海：推进氢能、绿色甲醇、可持续航空燃料等产品交易平台建设 - 36Kr
decision.reason: Shanghai municipal five-year plan promotes hydrogen, green methanol and SAF product-trading platform development, as reported by Yicai, prompting prospective supplier provenance and pretrade evidence preparation. Platform future launch, not a current live exchange.

opportunities.idea_name: Shanghai Green Fuel Pretrade Evidence Pack
opportunities.core_job: Prepare product batch provenance, certification and off-taker acceptance documentation before hydrogen/methanol/SAF exchange onboarding
opportunities.target_customer: Chinese low-carbon fuel producers and proposed Shanghai energy commodity marketplace onboarding teams
opportunities.product_mechanism: Manually imported fuel type/quantity, source electricity, supplier batch, lifecycle GHG document, buyer specs → missing-document checklist → reviewer-approved platform submission pack
opportunities.why_now: Shanghai's 2026-2030 energy/carbon plan explicitly calls for product trading platforms for hydrogen, green methanol and sustainable aviation fuel, with cap-and-trade coordination
opportunities.before_state: Different fuel product proof/certification and prospective exchange eligibility statements remain in spreadsheets and email
opportunities.after_state: Traceable low-carbon fuel batch/document readiness register for human review; no exchange connection, no carbon certificate issuance
